playstyle.identity: Braum is a protective tank support whose shield blocks all projectiles. He excels at peeling for carries and providing engage with his ultimate.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive stacks stuns with ally autos. Q slows and applies passive. W jumps to an ally, giving armor/MR. E shield blocks ALL projectiles from one direction. R knocks up in a line and creates a slow zone. Stand in front of carries, E to block, R to engage.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Braum spikes at level 6 with his engage ultimate. Tank items make him durable. He's strong at protecting carries at all stages.

passive.name: Concussive Blows
passive.summary: Autos and Q apply stacks; at 4 stacks, target is stunned.
passive.details: Braum's auto attacks apply Concussive Blows. After applying a stack, allies can add stacks with their autos. At 4 stacks, the target is stunned and takes bonus damage.

abilities.name: Winter's Bite
abilities.summary: Fire ice that slows and applies passive stack.
abilities.details: Braum propels ice from his shield, dealing damage, slowing, and applying a stack of Concussive Blows to the first enemy hit.

abilities.name: Stand Behind Me
abilities.summary: Jump to an ally, giving you both bonus armor and magic resist.
abilities.details: Braum leaps to an ally, positioning himself between them and enemies. Both Braum and the ally gain bonus armor and magic resist.

abilities.name: Unbreakable
abilities.summary: Raise shield that blocks ALL projectiles from that direction.
abilities.details: Braum raises his shield, blocking all projectiles from that direction. He takes reduced damage from the first hit and negates all subsequent hits while gaining movement speed.

abilities.name: Glacial Fissure
abilities.summary: Slam the ground to knock up enemies in a line and create a slow zone.
abilities.details: Braum slams the ground, creating a fissure that knocks up enemies in a line (first enemy hit is knocked up longer). A slow field persists in the area.
